text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: "The Oaks is over! Ah, that was fun!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Still, Hishi Amazon's fighting spirit was 
incredible as always! I'm really looking 
forward to the Shuka Sho now.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, didn't Hishi Amazon 
just get some new merch? Let's go check it 
out!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Past the midway point of the Tiara route, 
Hishi Amazon's true strength was steadily 
becoming known to the world."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Ah, what an insane showdown! As expected 
of the Oaks, it was nothing but monsters 
out there.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, thanks! Well, but... I've still got 
a long way to go!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Brian is sure to claim the second crown at 
next week's Nippon Derby. So I can't 
afford to space out.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"I'm gonna do everything I can at the 
Shuka Sho. I'll do my best, Trainer-guy!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so began the days of intense training 
leading up to the Shuka Sho!
